Formula.text:
Dim x As String
If {customer.tier} = "Strategic" Then
    x = "Top tier"
ElseIf {customer.tier} = "Key" Then
    x = "Key account"
Else
    x = "Standard or below"
End If
Formula = x

Dim lvl As String
If {customer.credit_limit} >= 150000 Then
    lvl = "High"
Else
    If {customer.credit_limit} >= 60000 Then
        lvl = "Medium"
    Else
        lvl = "Low"
    End If
End If
Formula = lvl

Dim total As Double
Select Case CDbl({customer.credit_limit})
    Case Is >= 150000
        total = CDbl({customer.credit_limit}) * 2
    Case Else
        total = CDbl({customer.credit_limit})
End Select
Formula = total
